name: manual_ae3b36
claim: Absence of board rows is not absence of work: before declaring a lane stalled or picking it up, check the owner's workspace mtimes and re-diff the live tree, and never integrate a copy made from a snapshot.

decisions.notes: A pickup copy made from a 10-minute-old snapshot would have removed the owner's private-file checks and reversed a deliberate no-immutable decision.

rationale: A pickup copy made from a 10-minute-old snapshot would have removed the owner's private-file checks and reversed a deliberate no-immutable decision.
